svg.title: Whole-run tokens per second, one RTX PRO 6000
svg.desc: Generated tokens divided by wall-clock play time, from each run's server log. Hatched: measured after 56.02 and never beat it on Kaggle. 22 Sep: our first stack (vLLM, no drafting). From 1 Oct: Daniel Franzen's notebook plus our changes, on our 25 to 75-game offline evaluation.
